glosses: to trouble, disturb
ongerust maken, zorgen baren

examples.text: De resultaten tot nu toe verontrusten hem nog niet.

glosses: in Unruhe versetzen

examples.text: Die Aufstände in einigen arabischen Ländern beunruhigen die Nachbarstaaten.

glosses: sich Sorgen machen

examples.text: Leider beunruhige ich mich wegen der Kinder, und das trotz der Postkarte, die ich gestern bekam.

glosses: to confuse a quiet, constant state or a calm, continuous flow, in particular: thoughts, actions or liquids.

examples.text: The noisy ventilation disturbed me during the exam.
The performance was disturbed twice by a ringing mobile phone.
A school of fish disturbed the water.

glosses: to divert, redirect, or alter by disturbing.

examples.text: A mudslide disturbed the course of the river.
The trauma disturbed his mind.
disturb his inmost counsels from their destined aim

glosses: to have a negative emotional impact; to cause emotional distress or confusion.
disturbance

examples.text: Instant without disturb they took alarm

glosses: Lack of quiet; absence of tranquility in body or mind

examples.text: My journey had been my own suggestion, and Elizabeth therefore acquiesced, but she was filled with disquiet at the idea of my suffering, away from her, the inroads of misery and grief.

glosses: Deprived of quiet; impatient, restless, uneasy.

examples.text: I pray you huſband be not ſo diſquiet. / The meate was well, if you were ſo contented.

[…] [O]ne day, as i was going to my boat, as uſual, i perceived on the ſand, the print of a man's naked foot, and had i ſeen an apparition, i could not have been more terrified.

glosses: To make (someone or something) worried or anxious.

examples.text: He felt disquieted by the lack of interest the child had shown.

glosses: Rendre inquiet.
target_senses.note: ne se dit qu’en parlant de l’âme

examples.text: Les subsistances, dans ce moment, inquiètent le gouvernement, elles inquiètent les gouvernés, elles inquiètent en particulier les fermiers ces derniers sont indécis sur le parti qu'ils doivent prendre pour la vente de leurs grains.

glosses: Ne pas laisser en repos.

examples.text: Ils prirent la résolution de décamper la nuit, à la seconde veille, de crainte que les Perses venant à s'appercevoir ^([sic]) de leur départ ne les suivissent et ne les inquiétassent dans leur marche.
